Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the 2003 and 2007 chest X-rays, there is a noticeable progression of fibrotic changes and increased pleural thickening/apical opacification in the upper lobes. In patients with chronic fibrotic sarcoidosis, these distorted upper lobe cavities are a classic predisposing factor for colonization by Aspergillus, leading to an aspergillus mycetoma (fungus ball).
